detail: Rows before 2024-02-13 flagged as scraper backfill: 283 rows over 48 days vs ~5,960/day after. Excluding these is mandatory for any time-series task.
Rows usable for daily counts: 240,548 (excludes backfill, truncated final day, 2024-02-15 outage)
HTML entities decoded, emoji stripped, unicode NFKC-normalised. Titles containing HTML entities before cleaning: 10,130
HTML entities decoded (e.g. 'Cote d'Ivoire'). Nulls mapped to 'Unknown' rather than dropped: 5,076
139 countries with <200 postings bucketed. Original retained in `country`; rate statistics must use `country_grouped` to stay stable.
Hourly midpoints outside $3-$250: 311. Fixed budgets outside $5-$50,000: 176. Flagged not dropped; medians reported throughout (budget mean $911 vs median $100).
Postings with no pay information: 38,514 (15.7%). All are hourly posts with an unspecified rate. NOT imputed - treated as the informative category 'rate undisclosed'.

Two-tier taxonomy applied (dataset has no category column). Tier 1 specific-phrase: 156,342 (63.9%). Tier 2 generic-token: 64,339 (26.3%). Unmatched: 24,146 (9.9%). Tier stored per row in `category_tier` so confidence is auditable.
